name: Oak Island Money Pit
description: Oak Island is a 57-hectare (140-acre) tree-covered island in Mahone Bay, Nova Scotia, the focus of one of the longest-running treasure hunts in history. Since 1795, expeditions have excavated the so-called 'Money Pit' in search of buried treasure, with multiple deaths but no verified treasure recovered.
origin: A single island in Mahone Bay, Nova Scotia, Canada, accessed from the village of Western Shore by a causeway constructed in 1965.
